pairing_point_field.name: Twelve points / many lines
pairing_point_field.description: Twelve points / many lines. A primitive changes what a hand or a walking body can do.

triangle_assembly_table.name: TriangleTable / folded edge assembly
triangle_assembly_table.label: TriangleTable / folded edge assembly
triangle_assembly_table.description: Twelve starting 32cm movable 3-sided panels. Select a fold from flat, bring two parallel free edges together and release. Lift a face to detach; other faces stay in place. Gold marks a candidate edge. Kinematic joins, not force-simulated glue. When no loose faces remain, six more appear in clear stock spaces. MORE FACES requests another batch. START OVER restores the authored starting faces. Near-edge stock and controls. DIAMOND selects the exact 70.5288 degree fold for eight triangles; TETRAHEDRON selects 109.4712 degrees.
triangle_assembly_table.qfep_connection: A boundary becomes an insertion frame. The same face can bound different spaces according to the relation at its edge.

parameters.fold_degrees: Signed fold from flat, degrees. Default 70.5288 (diamond / octahedron). Applies only to new joins.

interactions: Desktop: RMB pick/place; Q/E roll, R/F tilt.
XR: grip, rotate, bring edges together and release.
Angle minus/plus, other side, MORE FACES, start over.

align_tetrahedron.name: Align the tetrahedron
align_tetrahedron.description: Move the pink fourth vertex to its ring and release. Four faces become a grabbable striped solid; its enlarged recipe becomes the tetrahedron blocker.

align_wedge.name: Align the wedge
align_wedge.description: Move the pink sixth vertex to its ring and release. The closed prism is a handheld 55-percent version of the 1:1:2 wp profile; its larger version can block or support a path.

wedge_palace.name: Two approaches / one platform
wedge_palace.description: Two approaches / one platform. A primitive changes what a hand or a walking body can do.

corner_tetrahedron.name: A tetrahedron changes the corner
corner_tetrahedron.description: A tetrahedron changes the corner. A primitive changes what a hand or a walking body can do.

wedge_column.name: Same wedges / sculptural column
wedge_column.description: Six original prism_block scenes paired into three diamond modules. Fixed joints let the same geometry become sculpture after obstruction and ascent.
wedge_column.qfep_connection: A form acquires capacities through arrangement and its relation to another body: obstruction, support, silhouette and access.

wedge_mouse_model.name: Wedge mouse / a small labyrinth
wedge_mouse_model.description: Steer a bare brown wedge mouse through a small maze of 23 upright movable wedge walls to symmetric cheese at the far end. One joystick stands behind the mouse. Move a wall to change the route; a fallen mouse returns automatically without resetting the walls.
wedge_mouse_model.qfep_connection: A form acquires capacities through arrangement and its relation to another body: obstruction, support, silhouette and access.

tetrahedron_blocker.name: Striped tetrahedron blocker
tetrahedron_blocker.description: Four triangular faces close a tetrahedron. The enlarged alignment recipe becomes a solid obstruction.
tetrahedron_blocker.qfep_connection: The same closed form changes bodily access: obstruction or support depends on placement and orientation.

pyramid_blocker.name: Striped pyramid blocker
pyramid_blocker.description: Four triangular sides meet above a square base. Five faces enclose a blocking volume.
pyramid_blocker.qfep_connection: The same closed form changes bodily access: obstruction or support depends on placement and orientation.

wedge_blocker.name: Striped wedge / wp ramp
wedge_blocker.description: The original wp prism and collider. One metre wide, one metre high, two-metre run; floor-centred, rises towards +Z at facing zero.
wedge_blocker.qfep_connection: The same closed form changes bodily access: obstruction or support depends on placement and orientation.

platform_block.name: One-metre platform / structure 2
platform_block.description: A supporting cube above the existing slab. Adjacent copies make a larger platform; the wp high edge joins its top.
platform_block.qfep_connection: The same closed form changes bodily access: obstruction or support depends on placement and orientation.

void_cube_walkway.name: Cube + wedges / carried walk-up
void_cube_walkway.description: Thirty one-metre cubes and six original wp ramps form a walkable two-metre platform. Named pieces remain editable; Cube and Transformation instantiate the same construction recipe.
interactions: Walk up two connected rises and return
Move or copy individual members in the lab editor
Reuse the complete construction as a prefab
void_cube_walkway.qfep_connection: Access is produced by the relation between exact solids: the same cube blocks a path or supports it according to its placement.

square_assembly_table.name: Square faces / folded edge assembly
square_assembly_table.label: Square faces / folded edge assembly
square_assembly_table.description: Twelve starting 32cm movable 4-sided panels. Select a fold from flat, bring two parallel free edges together and release. Lift a face to detach; other faces stay in place. Gold marks a candidate edge. Kinematic joins, not force-simulated glue. When no loose faces remain, six more appear in clear stock spaces. MORE FACES requests another batch. START OVER restores the authored starting faces. Near-edge stock and controls. CUBE selects 90 degrees; FLAT selects zero.
square_assembly_table.qfep_connection: A boundary becomes an insertion frame. The same face can bound different spaces according to the relation at its edge.

parameters.fold_degrees: Signed fold from flat, degrees. Default 90. Applies only to new joins.

interactions: Desktop: RMB pick/place; Q/E roll, R/F tilt.
XR: grip, rotate, bring edges together and release.
Angle minus/plus, other side, MORE FACES, start over.
